evidence.quote: Participant has at least 1 measurable disease according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) 1.1
Participant has Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1.
Participant's tumor sample is positive for claudin (CLDN)18.2 expression by central immunohistochemistry (IHC) testing.

labels.note: CLDN18.2 phase 1 he fits on claudin, but measurable disease and ECOG 0-1 are required.

with documented disease progression on last standard treatment
